description: AutoZone, Inc. is a leading retailer and distributor of automotive replacement parts and accessories in the Americas. It began operations in 1979 and at August 30, 2025 operated 6,627 stores in the United States, 883 stores in Mexico and 147 stores in Brazil, each carrying an extensive product line for cars, sport utility vehicles, vans and light duty trucks, including new and remanufactured automotive hard parts, maintenance items, accessories and non-automotive products. In 6,098 of its domestic stores as well as the vast majority of its stores in Mexico and Brazil it has a commercial sales program that provides prompt delivery of parts and other products and commercial credit to local, regional and national repair garages, dealers, service stations, fleet owners and other accounts, and it also sells through www.autozone.com, www.autozonepro.com and the ALLDATA brand of automotive diagnostic products.
